FAIL_TO_PASS: follow-pattern-parameters: retains side-effect-free code in pattern parameters called from try-statement-blocks
return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
recursive-parameter-binding: Avoid maximum call stack error, make sure parameter value is optimized before hasEffects (#5499).
nullish-coalescing: supports tree-shaking with nullish-coalescing
if-statement-insert-whitespace: inserts necessary white-space when simplifying if-statements (#3419)
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
deoptimize-conditional-expression-reassignments: tracks reassignments of deoptimized conditional expressions
associate-function-parameter-mutations-2: Associates function parameters with their call arguments with regard to mutations
break-statement-labels-switch: supports labels when breaking control flow from a switch statement
deoptimize-logical-expression-reassignments: tracks reassignments of deoptimized logical expressions
unmodified-default-exports-function-argument: passing unbound default export to function cannot rebind it
destructured-known-arguments: tracks known argument values through destructuring
smallest: handles treeshake preset "smallest"
async-function-effects: tracks effects when awaiting thenables
invalid-property-calls: includes invalid property calls
deoptimize-call-expression-reassignments: deoptimizes call expressions of conditional expressions if their return value is reassigned
unused-parameters: removes arguments that correspond to unused parameters
invalid-property-assignments: includes invalid property assignments
deoptimize-computed-class-keys: deoptimizes computed class property keys
include-unused-destructured-getters-in-calls: destructures unused properties with getter side effects in calls
